description: This Java class is a test helper utility for managing Global Properties within the OpenMRS project. It provides methods to set and purge global properties by interacting with the AdministrationService, primarily used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: GlobalPropertiesTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class for testing global property management in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: GlobalPropertiesTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with an instance of AdministrationService.

methods.name: setGlobalProperty
methods.description: Sets a global property to a specified value and asserts the change took effect. Returns the previous value.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperty
methods.description: Removes a global property if it exists and asserts that it has been removed.
